title: bupleurum scorzonerifolium subsp. angustissimum
intro: Bupleurum scorzonerifolium subsp. angustissimum, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Hare's Ear, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Bupleurum scorzonerifolium subsp. angustissimum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
